description: Deletes a node from the Figma document. NEVER deletes artboards (top-level frames) — only child nodes within an artboard. To rebuild a screen, create a NEW artboard alongside the existing one. Destructive and irreversible via the API — verify the nodeId with figma_inspect first if unsure.

nodeId.description: Node ID to delete. Must NOT be a top-level artboard.

name: figma_delete_node
